Statuses mismatch-trace and abend-trace-mismatch (failures): the file tests' DISPLAY lines after every statement differ, with equal final storage or before an abend at the same statement with the same status; lines that set them
Status lean-unsupported-recursion (declined, not compared): the program re-enters an active PERFORM, which the model reports as unsupported (implementation-specific on IBM); line that sets it
Status ok-abend (counted as agreeing): GnuCOBOL and the model stop at the same statement with the same I/O status, and the DISPLAY lines of the statements before it agree; line that sets it

Status lean-unsupported-resume (declined, not compared): control reaches the end of a paragraph whose return slot belongs to an abandoned PERFORM; IBM would resume that PERFORM, which the model reports as unsupported; line that sets it

The 3 mismatches of V.dt_bin (cases 101, 130 and 197, kept as tools/difftest/bin_cases/T00101.cob, T00130.cob and T00197.cob): a binary item holds a value outside its PICTURE. GnuCOBOL DISPLAYs the full binary value but uses it truncated to the PICTURE digits in arithmetic (101: N4 = 5367323.33 + N2 with N2 = -15755.407 instead of -1015755.407; 197: N5 = 284683.386 - N2 with N2 = -326483.8 instead of -61326483.8; 130: N5 PIC S9(1) COMP holds 1999, and in one ADD N5 TO N6 N4 GnuCOBOL adds 9 to N6, so no size error and NOT ON SIZE ERROR runs, but 1999 to N4; minimal reproduction t130x.cob). The model uses the full binary value (under TRUNC(BIN) binary items are not truncated to their PICTURE): N6 overflows and ON SIZE ERROR runs. Case 130 shows only in the per-statement outcome trace (OTRACE): a later IF overwrote the single FLAG byte of the 2306Z tester.
